verdict.rationale: Viam documents logic modules that react to events, such as triggering an alert or actuator when a sensor crosses a threshold, commanding a motor when a camera detects an object, and scheduling actions. These can be written in an inline browser editor, and the platform also advertises fleet monitoring and alerting. However, the event-driven behavior has to be coded as a module rather than set up through a rules or trigger engine. Missing for 10: a no-code or declarative event-to-action rule configuration, documentation of alerting trigger setup, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
